item.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

item.tests: Tests a short, cohesive local-business promo that preserves the owner's actual photos across mixed source aspect ratios.

answer_sheet.Business and exact wording: Maple Street Café; opening text: Maple Street Café; closing text: Your morning starts here.
answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.

must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

turns.text: These are photos of my café. Make a cosy 9-second vertical Instagram reel using all three, storefront first. Gentle movement, soft upbeat music, no talking. Put “Maple Street Café” at the start and “Your morning starts here” at the end.

dialog.agent:
I haven’t generated the reel yet: Magic Hour’s current terms require a paid subscription or credit-pack purchase for commercial use, which includes promoting your café.

The planned **9-second, 9:16 reel** is:
- **0–3s:** Storefront, gentle push-in — “Maple Street Café”
- **3–6s:** Latte, slow close-up movement
- **6–9s:** Pastries, gentle pan — “Your morning starts here”

Soft upbeat instrumental music throughout, with no talking. Once commercial use is enabled, we can proceed with all three photos.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account doesn’t have enough credits, even at free-plan settings. **No video was generated.**

I kept all three photos, the 9-second duration, vertical format, music, and both text captions in the request. You’ll need more credits to retry that version.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create a cosy 9-second vertical 9:16 Instagram café reel using ALL THREE supplied photos as the actual visual references, not generic substitutes. Preserve the real café architecture, latte and pastry display. Three shots in this exact order: 0–3 seconds @storefront first, gentle slow push-in toward the café entrance, warm natural morning light. Overlay exact clearly legible title 'Maple Street Café' at the start in elegant cream lettering with subtle shadow, centered within Instagram safe margins. 3–6 seconds @latte, subtle slow camera drift and push-in on the cup on its marble table, preserve the leaf and foam detail. 6–9 seconds @pastries, gentle slow pan across the croissants and warm interior. End with exact clearly legible text 'Your morning starts here', within safe margins, held through the final frame. Soft unobtrusive transitions, cosy warm color grade, realistic imagery, restrained natural movement without warping. Audio: soft upbeat instrumental music, light acoustic guitar and mellow piano with a gentle beat. No talking, no voiceover, no singing, no vocal sounds. Exactly 9 seconds.
